title: Nonunique nearest stable complex quadratics

claims.proof: Actual proximal-normal sequence; nonproximal limit in every fixed SPD metric; monic closure/attainment and PRT1.3(a),(k).
All six real coefficient derivatives plus compact full-degree localization and global minimizer coincidence.
Scaled smooth epigraph covectors and nonproximal horizontal covector limit in any fixed mixed height metric.
Complete scalar subdifferentials; exact diffeomorphism transport; uniform bounded-subgradient lower quadratic support.

strongest_verified_result: All C1-C4 under the exact complex/closed-half-plane/fixed-SPD conventions and Euclidean finite-subgradient function convention.
exact_remaining_gap: No central mathematical gap identified. Bounded historical original-body coverage: Cross, Moses-Liu, Bottema; no firstness or present-day openness certificate. PR2010 Thm3.1 citation does not itself state exact subdifferential equality, but self-contained diffeomorphism argument proves the needed identity.
